title: Docs: add Model Release Notes section + generated per-model pages
author: Wei Chen
description: Summary: Adds a new customer-facing “Model release notes” section to the docs site, including (1) a landing page describing what model release notes are and how to use them for pinning/rollouts, (2) navigation updates (top-level nav + sidebar group) and (3) per-model landing pages generated from the published changelog feed produced by the model changelog pipeline. Motivation: Customers have repeatedly asked for a single, durable location for model updates (Console link + docs canonical). Today notes are scattered across ad-hoc announcements; this PR makes docs the stable entry point and allows deep-linking to model/version entries. Scope: This PR intentionally does not add RSS/Atom (tracked separately) and does not attempt to generate narrative quality diffs; it renders the approved customer-safe summaries and links back to Console for richer views. Implementation details: - Build-time fetch of published changelog feed JSON from Control Plane public feed endpoint (rate-limited + ETag support). We fetch once per build and write an artifact to `./.cache/model-changelog.json` so local builds don’t require network access. - Page generation: for each `model_id` in feed, generate a model page at `/models/<model_id>/release-notes` with latest entries and filters (Hosted/Dedicated/Private availability badges, “deprecated” callout when present). - A global index page at `/model-release-notes` listing models with last-updated date and quick links. - Version deep links: render each entry with a stable anchor based on `entry_id` (event id) and include a “Copy link” UI affordance (simple link icon) for support/CSM sharing. - Redaction / safety: docs renderer only consumes the public feed fields and will refuse to render unexpected fields (fail build) to prevent accidental leakage of internal-only metadata. - IA/nav: adds a new “Model release notes” item under Reference, per DES-214. Testing: - `pnpm test` (unit tests for feed parsing + grouping) - `pnpm build` (SSG) - `pnpm lint` - `pnpm link-check` (updated ignore list for local anchors) Manual: verified index + 3 sample model pages render correctly using a captured fixture feed; verified broken-feed behavior shows a safe fallback page with guidance and no stack traces. Rollout: merge behind existing docs deploy pipeline; no feature flag. If feed endpoint is unavailable during build, build fails (intentional) to avoid publishing stale/incomplete release notes without visibility; release engineering can re-run once feed is healthy.
